column1: # Every disagreement between this library and a reference that the differential
# (diff.py) is allowed to see, and why.
#   tag    which cases: fnmatch pattern against the case's tag (corpus.py), or
#          cases are named for the rule they hold; generated cases are
#          gen:<operation>[:<value>]@<where in the message the first changed byte
#   ref    llhttp, h11, gohttp, or * for any
#   kind   how the two answers differ: <ours>/<reference>[+what], where the ends
#          are clean, upgrade, incomplete or error, and `what` is count, start,
#          headers, body or trailers. fnmatch pattern; `error/*` is "this library
#          refuses and the reference does not", whatever else differs
#   class  one of the classes in diff.py's CLASSES
#   note   what is going on, in a sentence
# The first matching line wins, so a specific line goes before a general one.
# A line that explains no disagreement makes the run fail: this file cannot
# accumulate lines for things that stopped happening.
# The generated cases are one mutation of a valid message each, so a
# disagreement on one is about that mutation and nothing else; that is what
# lets a line here speak for a whole family of them. The families were checked
# by listing the cases behind each line (notes/http/README.md has the counts).
